kai: quick design/ux sync — new asks: permission inheritance visualization in roles matrix, inline permission-diff when editing a role, and final SSO toggle microcopy for invite modal. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW/roles-inheritance (frames: InheritanceViz, InviteSSO_Copy) sara: high level: customers asked for a clear way to see inherited permissions (from parent roles/teams) vs explicit role perms. idea: small pill tags under each role: "explicit" and "inherited" with a flyout that shows source role/team. miguel: tech note: flyout should be accessible and not heavy — we'll lazy-render details. prefer using a disclosure pattern `
New invites must sign in with your org SSO. Existing members unaffected.
``` and ensure the helper is visible to screen readers even if visually hidden. kai: another bug repro from staging: dark-mode tokens (role badges) lose contrast when showing permissive/critical colors. Steps: 1) enable dark mode 2) open org -> Access -> Roles 3) look at Admin badge — text contrast is ~2.8:1 zoe-a11y: fix: use solid background variants for badges in dark mode or increase text size/weight and add icon. also add `title` and visually hidden text describing severity, so color isn't the only signal. sara: permissions diff micro-interaction: when toggling a permission on a role in the modal, show transient toast "Permission X added to Role Y" with `role=status aria-live="polite"` so screen reader users get feedback. miguel: PR coming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/4521 — adds inheritance pills + flyout scaffolding and SSO helper copy. will add feature flag `roleInheritanceViz`. release-bot: preview-deploy: role-inheritance branch deployed to staging @ 2026-02-06T12:08:02Z :rocket: zoe-a11y: I'll run a focused a11y pass on staging once the PR is merged: check focus management on flyouts, reduced-motion behavior, dark-mode contrast, switch aria attributes, and permission-diff announcements. kai: next steps: lock on Opt A for SSO control, sara to update figma with pill/flyout visuals + helper copy, miguel to land small ARIA + reduced-motion changes behind flag. leaving thread open until staging a11y pass. :eyes:
